demons.effect: Return target artifact or enchantment from any graveyard to your hand. Exile target card from an opponent's graveyard. Draw a card.
demons.lore: Earl who returns stolen goods and discovers thieves.

vedic.name: Brahma
vedic.effect: Draw 5 cards. Create 5 tokens of any type. Gain 5 in all resources.
vedic.lore: The creator god, source of all existence and knowledge.

vedic.name: Vishnu
vedic.effect: Return all permanents from all graveyards to the battlefield. You gain life equal to their total mana cost.
vedic.lore: The preserver, maintaining cosmic order and balance.

vedic.name: Shiva
vedic.effect: Destroy all permanents. For each permanent destroyed, create a Treasure token. Draw 3 cards.
vedic.lore: The destroyer and transformer, dancing the cosmic dance.

vedic.name: Saraswati
vedic.effect: Draw 5 cards. Gain 5 Consciousness tokens. Your spells cost 2 less this turn.
vedic.lore: Goddess of knowledge, music, and arts.

vedic.name: Lakshmi
vedic.effect: Create 8 Treasure tokens. You gain 8 life. Draw 3 cards.
vedic.lore: Goddess of wealth, prosperity, and beauty.

norse.name: Odin
norse.effect: Sacrifice a permanent: Draw 3 cards and gain 3 Consciousness tokens. Repeat twice.
norse.lore: The Allfather who sacrificed his eye for wisdom.

norse.name: Thor
norse.effect: Deal 5 damage to each creature and planeswalker opponents control. Your creatures gain +3/+3 and Indestructible until end of turn.
norse.lore: God of thunder wielding mighty Mjolnir.

norse.name: Loki
norse.effect: Copy target spell or ability. Transform target creature into a copy of another target creature. Draw 2 cards.
norse.lore: The trickster god, master of chaos and change.

egyptian.name: Ra
egyptian.effect: Deal 8 damage divided among any number of targets. You gain life equal to damage dealt. Draw 3 cards.
egyptian.lore: The sun god, creator and sustainer of life.

egyptian.name: Anubis
egyptian.effect: Return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control. They're Zombies in addition to their types.
egyptian.lore: Guardian of the dead and guide to the afterlife.

egyptian.name: Isis
egyptian.effect: Return target permanent from a graveyard to the battlefield. Restore all damage. You gain 10 life. Draw 3 cards.
egyptian.lore: Goddess of magic, healing, and divine motherhood.
